distribution.summary: 贵州; 福建; 台湾
distribution.narrative: Mainland China occurrence is retained from 黄复生等 (2015) (贵州; 福建). Beaver & Liu (2010) adds a confirmed Taiwan record from Nantou, Neimoupu. The 2010 source also gives the broad distribution wording China (SW); Taiwan; no additional mainland province is inferred from that regional wording.

host_note: 黄复生等 (2015) reports Cucurbita sp., Luffa cylindrica and Canavalia sp. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Lagenaria vulgaris, Luffa cylindrica and Tinospora cordifolia. Luffa cylindrica is de-duplicated in the current synthesis; genus-level host records remain genus-level.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cosmoderes monilicollis Eichhoff, 1878.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cosmoderes monilicollis Eichhoff, 1878, VSN_1612 (Scolytinae: Trypophloeini). 黄复生等 (2015) preserves the published spelling Cosmoderes molinicollis and historical higher classification in its Source Record; Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cosmoderes monilicollis with authorship Eichhoff. Source-specific wording is retained without changing the stable VSN.
